ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent charges in Minnesota and follow the money trail to uncover the extent of the Medicaid fraud schemes
questions: How much money was lost due to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who were the key players involved in the schemes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable
